definition: five in number; totalling five.
example_en: There are five books on the table.

definition: to fasten, join, repair with stitches; to stitch.
example_en: He stitched up the torn sack.

definition: to engage in promiscuous sexual intercourse.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲವರು ಮಿಂಡಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು ಎಂದು ಜನ ಆಡಿಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: People gossiped that some in that town engaged in promiscuous relations.

definition: urging or imposing with authority; enjoining; enforcing; containing an injunction.
example_en: This law is of an enforcing, imposing nature.

definition: a sum of money or another reward or offered in order to influence to do or demanded to do, an illegal or dishonest action or decision in favour of the giver; bribe.
example: ಆ ಗುಮಾಸ್ತನು ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡಲು ಲಂಚ ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: That clerk asked for a bribe to get the work done.

definition: the quality or fact of being bright, splendid; splendidness.
example_en: The splendidness of that gem amazed everyone.

definition: a tusked elephant (but in gen. any elephant).
example_en: The tusked elephant walked slowly through the forest.

definition: young age.
example: ಕಿಱುವರೆಯದಲ್ಲೇ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸಂಗೀತದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಬಂತು.
example_en: He developed an interest in music even in his young age.

definition: a past incident, event or story narrated or portrayed at a later time inturrupting the continuity of the main story, play, movie etc.
example_en: In the middle of the film, a flashback interrupted the story.

definition: (pros.) a kind of meter.
example: ಈ ಪದ್ಯ ನವನಲಿನ ಎಂಬ ಛಂದಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಟ್ಟಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದೆ.
example_en: This verse is composed in the meter called navanalina.

definition: pleased; happy; delighted.
example_en: Hearing the result, the student became delighted.

definition: a rule ordinance or law by which conduct is regulated or restrained.
example_en: The work must proceed according to the department's rule.

definition: a man with flat-nose.
example_en: The children laughed seeing the flat-nosed man's face.

definition: a watery discharge from a mucous membrane of the eyes; the rheum of the eye.
example_en: His eyes were filled with rheum.

definition: the fluid flowing from the temples of an elephant in rut.
example_en: The musth fluid of the elephant in rut flowed down its cheek.

definition: a wedge-like tool with a cutting edge at the end of the blade, made of steel, used for cutting or shaping stone, metal, etc.; a chisel.
example_en: The stonemason used a chisel to carve the stone.

definition: (dance.) a moving of the head slowly from right to left and left to right, to indicate astonishment, dismay, denial, indifference, want of sympathy, etc.
example_en: The dancer showed her astonishment with a slow swaying of the head.

definition: the pavilion in front of a temple.
example_en: Preparations for the fair were going on in the temple's front pavilion.

definition: a village or small town.
example_en: The people of that small town are very simple.

definition: that has been cut; cut off.
example: ಆ ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗೆ ಗೌರವ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Honour was accorded to every important person at that gathering.

definition: a clan of kṣatriya caste originally inhabiting in the Sahyadri range of mountins.
example: ಮಾವಳಿ ಜನರು ಸಹ್ಯಾದ್ರಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಸಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The Mavali people lived in the Sahyadri mountain range.

definition: the act, fact or process of stimulating one's appetite.
example_en: The doctor stimulated his appetite through medicine.

definition: a feudal chieftain; a local feudal lord.
example_en: That petty chieftain strengthened his territory.

definition: (pl.) five types or kinds.
example_en: In the scripture, the five kinds of the five elements are described.

definition: a cornice - a) a horizontal molding projecting along the top of a wall, building, etc.; b) a projecting, decorative strip.
example_en: The cornice of the house was slightly damaged in the rain.

definition: to go back; to retreat.
example_en: The army retreated before the powerful enemy.

definition: the mouth with lips drawn back, showing the teeth, as in smiling broadly; a grinning face.
example_en: A broad grinning face appeared on him.

definition: a small ball like mass of opium.
example_en: A small ball of opium was found with the smugglers.

definition: a rigid support from below to keep a thing from falling or collapsing; a prop.
example: ಗೋಡೆಗೆ ಒಂದು ಅಡೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಬಿದ್ದು ಹೋಗದಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They put a prop to the wall so it would not fall.

definition: the place or region of gods, where the virtuous people settle after their death.
example: ಪುಣ್ಯವಂತರು ಮರಣದ ನಂತರ ನಾಕಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾರೆ ಎಂದು ನಂಬುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People believe that the virtuous go to heaven after death.

definition: particles of water vapour which when frozen in the upper air fall to earth as soft, white, crystalline flakes; snow.
example_en: Snow had fallen on the mountain peak.

definition: a thought, plan, scheme pondered over, which is not disclosed to another.
example_en: He did not tell his secret plan to anyone.

definition: the broad flat cheeck.
example_en: Her broad flat cheek turned red with shyness.

definition: in pieces; part by part.
example_en: They decided to finish the work part by part.

definition: the father of one's wife or husband; father-in-law.
example: ಮದುವೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ವಶುರನು ವಧುವಿಗೆ ಬಂಗಾರದ ಸರವನ್ನು ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: At the wedding the father-in-law gave the bride a gold necklace.

definition: the bird Sarcidiornis melanonotus, a species of duck.
example_en: The Sarcidiornis melanonotus duck sat on the pond's bank.

definition: small (in degree, size, importance, etc.).
example: ಆ ಪುಟಗೋಸಿ ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ಇಷ್ಟೊಂದು ಜಗಳ ಏಕೆ?
example_en: Why so much quarrel over that small matter?

definition: that which has lost moisture, liquid content; a dry, dehydrated thing.
example: ಬಿಸಿಲಿಗೆ ಒಣಕಲು ಆದ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಬೇಗ ಮಡಚಿದೆವು.
example_en: We quickly folded the clothes that had become dry in the sun.

definition: a man who is dead; the soul of the dead.
example_en: May peace come to the soul of that deceased man.

definition: a piece of iron that has the property of attracting other iron pieces; a magnet.
example_en: The magnet attracted the pieces of iron.

definition: to choose; to select; to elect.
example_en: They elected a new president in the meeting.

definition: that which has three angles; a plane figure bounded by three sides; a triangle.
example_en: He drew a triangle on that paper.

definition: the triad of three faculties the body, speech and mind.
example_en: The seeker offered worship with the purity of body, speech and mind.

definition: the fact of being homeless; homelessness.
example_en: After the war, many experienced homelessness.

definition: a man who cheats; a cheat; a fraud.
example_en: That cheat deceived the people.

definition: a story of adventure or heroic deeds; a saga.
example_en: Grandfather told the children an old saga of heroism.

definition: to raise an objection; to oppose; to argue against.
example_en: One member raised an objection to that resolution.

definition: any male peafowl, esp., one of a species (Pavo cristatus) with a crest of plumules and long, brightly coloured upper tail coverts; a peacock.
example_en: During the rainy season, the peacock spreads its plumes and dances.

definition: completely dehydrated as from heating; that is hard.
example_en: The cloth dried in the sun had become completely dehydrated and hard.

definition: (fig.) extra marital sexual relations.
example_en: His extramarital affair became known to everyone in the village.

definition: to make late; to slow up; to delay.
example_en: He delayed the work.

definition: to break one's promise; to fail to act as promissed.
example_en: He acted as promised without breaking his word.

definition: a kind of medicinal preparation.
example_en: They apply Bhairavanjana for eye ailments.

definition: an ornamental band, hoop or chain worn on the wrist; a bracelet.
example_en: The golden bracelet shone on her wrist.

definition: a microscopic opening the epidermis of the leaves of a plant; a cryptostoma.
example_en: Cryptostomata are visible under a microscope on the surface of the leaf.

definition: an urgent need for immediate action, attention, etc.
example_en: There is a great urgency for this work.

definition: the supernatural power of a person who has manifested in the world for a special purpose.
example: ಆ ಸ್ವಾಮಿಗಳ ಕಾರಣಿಕೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಜನರು ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People talk about that saint's supernatural power.

definition: sediment precipitated from a liquid; solid particles of a liquid forming a residue; dregs.
example_en: Sediment of oil had collected at the bottom of the vessel.

definition: originally - a) with reference to origin or beginning; b) in the first place; initially; c) in an original manner.
example: ಈ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ಮೂಲತಃ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಿಂದ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: This custom originally came from the rural area.

definition: a thorny bush.
example_en: They had planted thorny bushes around the fence.

definition: a strong, offensive smell; stench; stink.
example_en: A strong stench was coming from the drain.

definition: the part of a flowering plant that contains the embryo with food stored for its development into a new plant under proper conditions; a seed.
example_en: The farmer sowed the seeds in the soil.

definition: the shell of any marine mollusk; a sea-shell.
example_en: She made a necklace out of sea-shells.

definition: a deep, torturing sense of guilt felt over a wrong that one has done; self-reproach; remorse; repentance.
example: ತಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡಿದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುತಾಪ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was remorse in his mind for the wrong he had done.

definition: to bend; to stoop; to shrink.
example_en: He stooped his back carrying the load.

definition: a kind of folk song.
example_en: The villagers sang the folk song dimisale at night.

definition: a losing or being lost; loss.
example_en: He suffered a loss from that agreement.

definition: a covering fastened under the rafters of a roof.
example_en: When the rain came, the roof covering under the rafters stopped the water.

definition: a false statement, deceptive appearance or show; a fraudulent or hypocritical action.
example_en: People grew weary seeing his hypocritical pretence.

definition: to stab, pierce from a side.
example_en: He stabbed from the side with a sword.

definition: the joint that connects the foot and the leg; the ankle.
example_en: His ankle was injured and it became hard for him to walk.

definition: the herb Hibiscus esculentus, of Malvaceae family.
example_en: Mother made a dish of okra.

definition: a man whose life, property, etc. is insured against loss; an insured (man).
example_en: Every insured person must pay the premium.

definition: the evergreen tree Garcinia indica of Guttiferae family.
example: ಮುರಕಿಲ ಮರದ ಹಣ್ಣಿನಿಂದ ಹುಳಿ ಸಾರು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They make a sour curry from the fruit of the murakila tree.

definition: (music) any of the attendant higher tones heard with a fundamental tone produced by the vibration of a given string or column of air, having a frequency of vibration that is an exact multiple of the frequency of the fundamental; an overtone.
example_en: The overtone of that instrument was heard clearly.

definition: ten kinds of dramas.
example: ಆ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸ ದಶರೂಪಕದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಗ್ರಂಥ ಬರೆದ.
example_en: That scholar wrote a treatise on the ten kinds of dramas.

definition: the adjoining area.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಕಿರಾಯತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ರಸ್ತೆ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: A new road has been built in the adjoining area of that town.

definition: a movement, usu., continuously or frequently, from back to forth, from side or up and down, causing tremble or vibrations.
example_en: The houses shook due to the trembling of the earthquake.

definition: a small pond or a small stream (?).
example: ಊರಿನ ಹೊರಗೆ ಒಂದು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಅಣ್ಣ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a small pond outside the village.

definition: brilliant; shining; luminous.
example_en: That gem shone brilliantly.

definition: to be cursed.
example: ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬ ದೇವರಿಂದ ಸಾಪಂದಳಿಸಿತು ಎಂದು ಜನರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: People said that the family was cursed by the god.

definition: the glory, dignity of one's military status or power.
example_en: The commander's military glory was revealed on the battlefield.

definition: the act of reserving something for a particular purpose, for a person, community, caste, etc.
example_en: The government announced reservation for the backward classes.

definition: the quality of being disdainfully proud; snobbishness; haughtiness.
example_en: Her haughtiness greatly irritated her classmates.

definition: to be of the opinion.
example_en: I am of the opinion that this plan is good.

definition: (in pl. only) unevenness; irregular surfaces.
example_en: Unevenness was clearly visible on the wall.

definition: he who sells; a seller; a merchant.
example_en: That merchant trades honestly.

definition: the concern one has for another.
example: ಅವಳಿಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ವಂತ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಪರಚಿಂತೆಯೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚು.
example_en: She has more concern for others than for her own work.

definition: to set up a camp (for a troop).
example_en: The army set up camp on the river bank.

definition: the state of being noiseless; calmness; quietude.
example_en: No one spoke in the quiet of the night.

definition: cleverness; deftness; dexterity; ingenuity.
example_en: Everyone knew her cleverness in speech.

definition: smiled; having a smile on the face.
example_en: His smiling face attracted everyone.

definition: to kiss; to give a buss.
example_en: The mother lovingly kissed the child's forehead.

definition: a gluttonous man.
example_en: Being a glutton, he ate up all the food.

definition: to put or set in a pile; to heap up.
example_en: The farmer heaped up the hay in the corner of the field.

definition: the back or hind part; backside.
example_en: They kept the chickens at the back of the hut.

definition: a collar-belt of an elephant or horse.
example_en: They had tied a golden collar-belt around the elephant's neck.

definition: the dullness of the power of eye-sight.
example_en: As he grew old, he developed dullness of eyesight.

definition: the basil plant Ocimum basilicum of Lamiaceae family; sweet basil.
example_en: They have grown a sweet basil plant in the house courtyard.

definition: to cause to go under the surface (of a liquid); to dip; to immerse.
example_en: He dipped the cloth in water and washed it.

definition: a friend of the bridegroom in a marriage.
example: ಮದುವೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವರನ ತೋಳ ಎಲ್ಲ ಏರ್ಪಾಡುಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: At the wedding, the bridegroom's friend looked after all the arrangements.

definition: the leguminous tree Tamarindus indica of Caesalpiniaceae family; tamarind.
example: ಪುಣುಸೆ ಮರದ ನೆರಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನ ವಿಶ್ರಮಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The village people were resting in the shade of the tamarind tree.

definition: a branch of chemistry in the Middle Ages, concerned with changing base metals into gold; alchemy.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸರು ರಸವಾದದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿನ್ನ ತಯಾರಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Ancient scholars tried to make gold through alchemy.

definition: one who accepts esp. one who signs an agreement of a contract.
example_en: The contractor signed the papers.

definition: a small, usu. hard, tumorous growth on the skin, caused by a virus; a wart.
example_en: A wart has grown on his back.

definition: to provide with; to supply.
example_en: The government supplied water to the villagers.

definition: a person professing belief in Jesus as the Christ or in the religion based on the teachings of Jesus; a Christian.
example: ಆ ಕಿರಿಸ್ತಾನನು ಪ್ರತಿ ಭಾನುವಾರ ಚರ್ಚಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That Christian goes to church every Sunday.

definition: the state of the sky being free from clouds, mists.
example: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಆಕಾಶದ ಹೊರಪು ಕಂಡು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸಂತೋಷಪಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: Everyone was happy to see the clear sky in the morning.

definition: the short stumps of grain, corn, etc., collectively, left standing after harvesting; a stubble.
example_en: The farmers burned the stubble and cleaned the field.

definition: a praising of oneself; self-commendation; self-glorification.
example_en: People grew weary hearing his self-glorification.

definition: to join together; to associate oneself with.
example_en: Both musicians joined together on the same stage.

definition: intermediate or intervening; in between; middle.
example_en: His role between the two is an intermediary one.

definition: a kind of paddy.
example_en: The farmers sowed the hudikke variety of paddy in the field.

definition: melted rock issuing from a volcano; lava.
example_en: Hot lava flowed from the volcano.

definition: the act of producing a sound.
example_en: The sound produced by that instrument enchanted the audience.

definition: a very young child; a baby; an infant.
example_en: She was breastfeeding the infant.

definition: the military forces of a nation, exclusive of the navy and the air force; army.
example_en: The army stood alert on guard at the border.

definition: to grow and put forth young leaves (as a creeper).
example_en: After the rain came, the creeper grew and put forth young leaves.

definition: to cause to glitter, sparkle.
example: ಅವಳು ಕನ್ನಡಿಯನ್ನು ಮಿರುಗಿಸಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಬೀಳುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She made the mirror glitter so that it caught everyone's eye.

definition: to hinder, obstruct another's movement.
example_en: The wind hindered our movement.

definition: that which is seen, available everywhere or in plenty.
example_en: These fruits are available in plenty in the market.

definition: a set of two umbrellas.
example_en: They held a pair of umbrellas in the wedding procession.

definition: a group of people.
example_en: A group of people had gathered on the ground.

definition: a tool for chopping trees, as an axe.
example_en: He chopped the tree with the axe.

definition: the quality or fact of being transitory; impermanence; transitoriness.
example_en: One who realizes the impermanence of life is happy.

definition: a person who is eligible for a share in the inherited property of the family.
example_en: There are three people eligible for a share in that property.

definition: to overcome (in a physical combat); to defeat.
example_en: In the wrestling match he defeated his opponent.

definition: to emit harsh, shrill sound; to screech.
example_en: The bird screeched from the nest.

definition: a loud, continuous, rumbling sound as of a lion, flood-water, etc.; roar.
example_en: The roar of the flood-water was heard even from a distance.

definition: a being impartial; impartiality; unbiasedness.
example_en: The judge delivered the verdict with impartiality.

definition: to lose one's kingship.
example_en: Having lost the war, that ruler lost his kingship.

definition: any of a series of rapid, heavy breaths, as from exertion; gasp.
example_en: He got out of breath, gasping, after running.

definition: a dull, boring or uninteresting work.
example_en: The work at that office was just dull and boring.

definition: an onomatopoeic word to denote intensity of heat, emptiness, unbearableness etc.
example_en: In the sunshine the desert was blazing with a scorching intensity.

definition: an analysis, enquiry or examination, in detail, of information on facts for arriving at a conclusion.
example_en: The police conducted an enquiry into the incident.

definition: a level higher than (another).
example_en: This post is at a higher level than the previous one.

definition: a wide spread (but, usu. baseless or unconfirmed) news; rumour.
example_en: A widespread rumour about the election was spreading.

definition: the art of creating illusions (in a huge scale).
example_en: That magician was an expert in the art of grand illusions.

definition: anything that is small, tiny or little.
example: ಆ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಚುಚ್ಚು ಮಾತ್ರ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was only one tiny thing in that box.

definition: a metal stand that holds a lamp or lamps.
example_en: She placed the lamp on the metal lamp stand.

definition: of this kind, sort.
example_en: He did not agree to do that kind of work.

definition: the act or process of minting monetary coins.
example_en: The minting of coins was going on in the kingdom's mint.

definition: the quality of being disciplined, well-trained, self-controlled and law-abiding.
example_en: His discipline was a model for everyone.

definition: a screen, curtain or veil.
example_en: They lowered a screen in front of the stage.

definition: a false alarm, fear.
example_en: It turned out to be just a false alarm.

definition: a half-ripe or ripening fruit.
example_en: He plucked a half-ripe fruit from the tree and brought it.

definition: physical effort; employment at a job; occupation; profession; business.
example_en: His occupation was very difficult.

definition: the main entrance of a town.
example_en: A crowd had gathered near the main entrance of the town.

definition: a verbal quarrel.
example_en: A verbal quarrel took place between the two of them.

definition: a mystical syllable in a hymn.
example_en: The guru taught the disciple the mystical syllable of the hymn.

definition: to give solace or comfort; to console.
example_en: The friend consoled the grieving person.

definition: the creator of smoke; fire.
example_en: Fire is also called the creator of smoke.

definition: a kind of tan silk produced from the fibres made from the cocoons of the silkworm Anthera mylitta.
example_en: This sari is woven from Dasara tussar silk.

definition: a slighting or being slighted by pointedly indifferent, disrespectful or supercilious treatment; slight.
example_en: Slight (disrespectful indifference) was clearly evident in his behaviour.

definition: a woman belonging to the community of smiths working in bronze, brass etc; a brazier woman.
example: ಕಂಚಗಾರ್ತಿ ತನ್ನ ಅಂಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿತ್ತಾಳೆಯ ಪಾತ್ರೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾರುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: The brazier woman was selling brass vessels in her shop.

definition: a village, town.
example_en: This village lies amidst the hills.

definition: Nārada, the sage of the heaven.
example_en: The heavenly sage Narada descended from the world of the gods to the earth.

definition: a small, solid mass formed in some gall-bladders or bile ducts, formed of cholesterol or, occasionally, of calcium salts, and sometimes obstruct the flow of bile, causing pain, jaundice, and other symptoms; biliary calculus: gall-stone.
example_en: The doctor removed the gall-stone through surgery.

definition: (masc.) a village-dweller.
example_en: The village-dweller came to the city and lost his way.

definition: the quality of being adamant or inflexible; unrelentingness.
example_en: No one could persuade him because of his inflexibility.

definition: a structure of railings held up by small posts, as on a staircase; a balustrade.
example_en: They constructed a balustrade around the raised platform.

definition: skill in using one's hand; dexterity.
example_en: Everyone was amazed at the carpenter's dexterity.

definition: a non-reigning female member of a royal family; a daughter of a king; a princess.
example_en: The princess went to the palace of the neighbouring kingdom.

definition: to lose one's strength, stamina.

definition: a man who is beside another or near.
example: ಮಂತ್ರಿಯ ಪಾರ್ಶ್ವಚರ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಅವನ ಬಳಿಯೇ ಇರುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The minister's attendant always stayed close beside him.

definition: to talk proudly about one's deeds, abilities; to boast.
example: ಆ ಪೈಲ್ವಾನ ತನ್ನ ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬಾಯ್ಕೊರ್ಚಿದನು.
example_en: That wrestler boasted about his strength.

definition: the superintendent of a harem in a palace.
example_en: The superintendent of the harem looked after the queens' chambers in the palace.

definition: to fill to bursting; to stuff; to cram.
example_en: He stuffed the bag with clothes.

definition: a predetermined purpose.
example_en: His journey proceeded according to the predetermined plan.

definition: (in comp.) a man resembling or is at par with, etc.
example_en: He is a man resembling his father.

definition: a commandment or direction meant as a rule of action or conduct ; a precept.
example_en: The disciples followed the precept given by the teacher.

definition: that which is digestible.
example_en: Rice is a digestible food.

definition: gold in its purest form.
example_en: That ornament was made from pure gold.

definition: pushed down or thrown out.
example_en: He was thrown out and pushed down from the assembly.

definition: the red or orange coating that forms on the surface of iron when exposed to air and moisture; iron rust.
example_en: Rust had formed on the old iron rod.

definition: an outer, upper garment, with or without sleeves, of women.
example_en: In the ancient sculpture, the woman is wearing an upper garment.

definition: he who cooks his food himself.
example_en: That ascetic cooks his own food.

definition: the condition of being a prisoner; imprisonment.
example_en: He spent many years in imprisonment.

definition: to make harsh, grating sound.
example_en: The old door made a harsh grating sound while opening.

definition: a man who gets secret information about another's affairs, plans, etc.; a spy.
example_en: He is a spy who collects information about the enemies.

definition: the plant Solanum surattense (=S. xanthocarpum) of Solanaceae family.
example_en: The roots of the Solanum surattense plant are used in medicine.

definition: (hist.) a kind of tax.
example: ಪೊನ್ನಾಯ ಎಂಬ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಚಿನ್ನದ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳ ಮೇಲಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The tax called ponnaya was levied on gold traders.

definition: wide knowledge; scholarship.
example: ಆ ಗುರುಗಳ ವಿನ್ನಾಣ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That teacher's scholarship was famous throughout the town.

definition: low or relatively low in height; not tall.
example_en: He is a short, not-tall man.

definition: that which has broad scales; a fish.
example_en: A broad-scaled fish was seen in the river.

definition: to collect; to gather together; to muster.
example_en: He collected old coins together.
